description: Capability-token and revocation-entry minting vectors for protocol version 1: the exact bytes a conformant minter produces from fixed Ed25519 identities (whose signatures are deterministic), the refusal reason of every rule a delegation or an authorised-by mint can break, and the verdicts of the pure queries canGrant and canGrantVia. The top-level vectors are every minted token and revocation entry, round-tripped like any other file; the `mint` section holds the inputs of each case and what it must produce. Each identity is made up for these vectors and is test material only.
